expectations.text: States yes: mutual adequacy has applied since January 2026
expectations.evidence: 'Yes. Since January 2026... mutual adequacy on 26-27 January 2026'

expectations.text: Cites ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD 32/2026 under Article 33, I
expectations.evidence: 'ANPD recognised the EU as adequate through Resolution CD/ANPD 32/2026 (LGPD Art. 33, I)'

expectations.text: States the carve-outs: public safety, national defence, State security, criminal investigation/prosecution
expectations.evidence: 'excludes transfers for public safety, national defence, State security, and criminal investigation or prosecution'

expectations.text: Keeps SCCs (Res. 19/2024) and BCRs available for excluded scopes and other countries
expectations.evidence: Keeps Res. CD/ANPD 19/2024 SCCs and BCRs for non-adequate destinations and says excluded purposes need another mechanism
